request: TGserver dedicated Gateway key: real host credential-name and existing project label preflight

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; echo TG_HEAD=$(git -C /home/admin1/projects/TGserver rev-parse --short HEAD); echo TG_STATUS=$(git -C /home/admin1/projects/TGserver status --porcelain | wc -l); echo TG_ACTION_SECRETS_BEGIN; gh secret list -R seigo-gace/TGserver --json name -q '.[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'GATEWAY|INTERNAL|DEVLOG|PROJECT' || true; echo TG_ACTION_SECRETS_END; echo GATEWAY_PROJECT_KEY_LABELS_BEGIN; python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("/home/admin1/projects/webhook-gateway/.env"); d={}; [(d.__setitem__(*l.split("=",1))) for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in l and not l.lstrip().startswith("#")] if p.exists() else None; v=d.get("INTERNAL_EVENT_API_PROJECT_KEYS_JSON",""); print("KEY_CONFIG_PRESENT="+str(bool(v))); print("PROJECT_LABELS="+",".join(sorted(json.loads(v).keys())) if v else "PROJECT_LABELS=NONE")' ; echo TG_PRODUCER_REFERENCES; git -C /home/admin1/projects/TGserver grep -n -E 'DEVLOG_GATEWAY_TOKEN|GATEWAY_INTERNAL_EVENT_API_TOKEN|INTERNAL_EVENT_API_PROJECT|tgserver-development-events' -- collector .github 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head -30 || true
